selection_basis: No-op-vs-no-op town draws on seeds 5000-5099; stratified by realized 30-day drain and missing product channels.
rationale: All seeds have eight shop instances and strawberry appears on all 100, so presence-only buckets are uninformative. The panel spans no-dairy, one-dairy-channel, high/low milk, high/low wool, high/low strawberry, missing egg, and reduced product-variety draws. The first two seeds are fixed racing representatives: one productive dairy draw and the sole no-milk/no-wool draw.
